title: Toolbox pane renders too small (sizing/resolution issue)
description: User report: the toolbox left pane is very small, possibly a resolution/DPI issue. Investigate ToolsPanel/Shell layout sizing (fixed px widths vs devicePixelRatio, flex shrink). Flash 8 reference: single fixed-width tool column area (Tools/View/Colors/Options sections, 2-column icon grid) that does not shrink with window size. Verify at 1x and 2x DPR and at small window sizes. See docs/04-toolbox.md.
